integrity: The exact IDRDF predicate is independently checked. Degree-one private leaves and positive-support independence force exactly three local pair labels, and a 2-labeled leaf occurs precisely at a core vertex in the open neighborhood of the independent core-3 set. This gives a two-way bijection between all feasible IDRDFs and pairs of an independent set with a subset of its neighborhood; the weight and optimal-count formulas follow without relying on finite experiments. A standalone checker enumerates the complete 0/1/2/3 assignment space for 79 base graphs (8,421,904 assignments).
scientific_limitations: Applies to the leaf corona with exactly one pendant neighbor per original vertex, not arbitrary graph products.
The recovered independent-set neighborhood-size polynomial is an invariant, not a complete graph isomorphism invariant.
The prior 2022 tree-corona theorem already describes a restricted extremal construction; this result claims the complete feasible-function enumeration, transform, and minimum-function coefficient.
Exhaustive computation is finite; the theorem is established for all finite simple base graphs by a direct bijection.
The 2022 publisher PDF could not be completely inspected; relevant Theorem 3 and proof were materially available in indexed HTML, leaving a stated access residual risk.
title: The independent double Roman weight enumerator of leaf coronas
